action.office.inventory.desc: Reads the installation (Click-to-Run or MSI), version, update channel, architecture, executables, running processes, COM add-ins, Word STARTUP folder templates, Normal.dotm and disabled items. Read-only.
action.office.measure-word-start.desc: Starts Word with /q /n (no splash, no document), measures milliseconds until the main window appears and closes Word politely (only the started process is ended if it does not close within 10 s). Refuses if Word is already running. The first start after boot is usually slower: compare measurements of the same kind.
action.office.measure-word-start-safe: Measure Word startup in safe mode
action.office.measure-word-start-safe.de: Same measurement with /safe (no add-ins or startup templates). Compared with the normal measurement: if normal is more than 2x safe and the difference exceeds 3 s, add-ins/templates are the likely cause (heuristic, not proof).
action.office.open-repair.desc: Opens Settings > Apps. There, choose Microsoft 365/Office > Modify > Quick Repair or Online Repair. WinCare never runs a repair by itself.
office.verdict.addins-likely: Add-ins/templates are the likely cause of the slowness (heuristic: normal > 2x safe and difference > 3 s).
office.verdict.no-clear-difference: No clear difference between normal and safe mode: add-ins/templates are probably not the main cause.
office.verdict.incomplete: Take one normal and one safe-mode measurement to compare.
office.refused-running: Word is already running. Close Word and try again: measuring with Word open invalidates the result.
office.managed: Managed by organization (Office policies present). WinCare does not change policies.
